key_card.title: Pair using Key Card
key_card.description:
Scan the QR code from the Eqiva Key Card. Then hold the unlock button on the lock until the yellow LED flashes and submit this form. Key Card data is not stored after pairing.

error.not_found: The lock was not found after a 10 second active Bluetooth scan and no Eqiva advertisement with manufacturer ID 0x1A00 was received.
error.no_scanner: Home Assistant has no connectable Bluetooth adapter or active Bluetooth proxy.
error.address_mismatch: An Eqiva lock was found under a different Bluetooth address. Check the MAC address from the Key Card or ESP configuration.
error.invalid_key_card: The Key Card data is invalid.
error.pairing_failed: Bluetooth and the KeyBLE handshake work, but pairing failed. Check the Key Card and pairing mode.
error.invalid_credentials: The Bluetooth address, user ID, or user key is invalid.
error.cannot_connect: Unexpected error while accessing the lock. The technical diagnosis below contains more detail.
error.connection_failed: Bluetooth connection to the lock or access to the Eqiva GATT profile failed.
error.handshake_failed: Bluetooth is connected, but the lock did not answer the KeyBLE connection handshake. Close the Eqiva app and temporarily stop other KeyBLE bridges.
error.authentication_failed: The KeyBLE connection works, but authentication failed. Check the user ID and user key.

abort.not_supported: The discovered Bluetooth device is not a supported Eqiva lock.

error.invalid_knx_group_address: Enter a valid KNX group address, for example 1/2/3.
error.duplicate_knx_group_address: Each KNX function must use a different group address.
error.knx_no_addresses: Enter at least one group address before enabling KNX.

init.title: Eqiva lock options
init.description: Configure Bluetooth and the optional connection to the existing Home Assistant KNX/IP integration. KNX addresses may be entered freely; unused functions can remain empty.

data_description.connection_mode: Live mode keeps the KeyBLE connection open, reports manual lock changes immediately and reconnects automatically if the link drops. Other Bluetooth clients such as the Eqiva app cannot connect at the same time.
data_description.poll_interval: Time between full status synchronizations. In energy-saving mode this is the normal polling interval; in live mode it acts as an additional resync interval.
data_description.knx_enabled: Uses Home Assistant's existing KNX/IP connection. No second KNX tunnel is opened.
data_description.knx_lock_address: DPT 1. Only an incoming value 1 triggers the command; 0 is ignored.
data_description.knx_unlock_address: DPT 1. Only an incoming value 1 triggers the command; 0 is ignored.
data_description.knx_open_address: DPT 1. Only an incoming value 1 retracts the latch; 0 is ignored.
data_description.knx_locked_state_address: DPT 1. 1 means locked, 0 means not locked. Read requests are answered.
data_description.knx_battery_low_address: DPT 1. 1 means the battery is low. Read requests are answered.
data_description.knx_available_address: DPT 1. 1 means the last lock communication was successful. Read requests are answered.
